rows.notes: Conceptual/opinion paper (Methodology: 'case studies and conceptual methods'; problems summarised from historical information, a concept and flowchart proposed). No own data, experiment, survey, measurements or model runs are reported; Table 1 is a qualitative list of weather-related problems without data. The paper asserts that mobile weather forecasting apps could reduce weather-related losses (including irrigation water/energy) and recommends a pilot project to test feasibility, but presents no empirical result on app-based scheduling or risk mitigation. Q1 'no', therefore Q2-Q9 'no'.

notes: Full text appears complete (pp. 53-61). The study is a conceptual extension article with no primary data; it does not mention DSS integration specifically, only mobile weather forecasting apps as a proposed aid for farmer decisions.
